svg.aria-label: QBM-09 · Iron uptake and sulfate assimilation
svg.text: QBM-09 · Iron uptake and sulfate assimilation
Where the Arabidopsis near-null-field evidence is strongest — and where the review

g.title: Cellular Fe / S supply tier T2 (verified) quantum class: structural_context Islam2020: The geomagnetic field contributes to efficient iron uptake in Arabidopsis; reducing it to near-null affects root metal reductase activity. [10.3389/fpls.2020.00325] Vigani2021: Geomagnetic-field-dependent modulation of iron-sulfur interplay in Arabidopsis, most pronounced under combined Fe and S deficiency. [10.3390/ijms221810166] Narayana2018: Reduction of the geomagnetic field to near-null affects Arabidopsis root mineral nutrition. [10.1016/j.lssr.2018.08.005] rationale: Note carefully what the cited work does and does not show. Islam 2020 and Vigani 2021 measured iron uptake and Fe-S interplay under altered field conditions — nutritional physiology. Neither measured cluster assembly. This entity is T2 because the field effect is demonstrated for the process it names; the assembly entities above remain T3 because that evidence does not reach them.

Root iron uptake (FRO2, IRT1, FIT) tier T2 (verified) quantum class: structural_context AGI: AT1G01580, AT4G19690, AT2G28160, AT3G56970, AT3G56980, AT1G23020 Islam2020: The geomagnetic field contributes to efficient iron uptake in Arabidopsis; near-null conditions affect root metal reductase activity. [10.3389/fpls.2020.00325] Narayana2018: Near-null magnetic field conditions affect Arabidopsis root mineral nutrition. [10.1016/j.lssr.2018.08.005] rationale: Carries demonstrated near-null-field evidence and NO proposed quantum route, and is classed structural_context to say so. Islam et al. measured reduced root metal reductase activity under field reduction — a real, reproducible effect with no mechanism attached. FRO2 is a flavocytochrome with FAD and two hemes, so a spin route could be argued; the review does not argue it, and no measurement supports it, so it is not claimed here.

Sulfate assimilation (SULTR, APS1, APR, SIR) tier T2 (reported) quantum class: iron_sulfur_4Fe4S nuclei: 57Fe, 33S AGI: AT4G08620, AT1G78000, AT5G10180, AT3G22890, AT4G04610, AT1G62180, AT4G21990, AT5G04590 Vigani2021: Field conditions modulate Fe-S interplay in Arabidopsis, most strongly under combined iron and sulfur deficiency. [10.3390/ijms221810166] rationale: Sulfite reductase carries a siroheme-[4Fe-4S] cofactor and is ferredoxin- dependent, so this pathway both consumes plastid reducing power and contains an Fe/S centre. It also supplies the sulfide that every cluster on QBM-04 is built from — a genuine feedback loop rather than a linear dependency.
Iron storage and distribution (FER1/4, NAS4, NRAMP3/4) tier T4 (verified) quantum class: structural_context AGI: AT5G01600, AT2G40300, AT1G56430, AT2G23150, AT5G67330, AT3G12750
Cysteine synthesis (SAT1, OASA1) tier T4 (verified) quantum class: structural_context AGI: AT1G55920, AT4G14880
Cysteine desulfurase NFS1 (ISC) tier T4 (inferred) quantum class: structural_context AGI: AT5G65720

Scaffold ISU1 (ISC) tier T3 (inferred) quantum class: iron_sulfur_2Fe2S nuclei: 57Fe, 33S AGI: AT4G22220 rationale: Holds a transient, solvent-exposed [2Fe-2S] cluster whose assembly involves iron redox chemistry and sulfide transfer. A nascent cluster on a scaffold is more exposed and shorter-lived than a mature one buried in a protein, which makes it a more credible point of perturbation than the finished product.
caveat: Entirely untested. No experiment has measured scaffold occupancy or transfer rate under any magnetic field condition.

SUF system (plastid assembly) tier T3 (inferred) quantum class: iron_sulfur_4Fe4S nuclei: 57Fe, 33S AGI: AT1G08490, AT4G26500 rationale: Builds every cluster in the chloroplast, including PSI's FX/FA/FB and ferredoxin's [2Fe-2S]. It is the single upstream dependency of QBM-02's strongest nodes.

Fe/S client proteins tier T3 (inferred) quantum class: iron_sulfur_4Fe4S, iron_sulfur_2Fe2S nuclei: 57Fe, 33S AGI: AT4G35830, AT5G66760, AT5G13430, AT4G03280, AT1G10960, AT2G20860, AT2G21790 rationale: Collected here so the map can show, in one edge, that a single assembly defect reaches respiration, photosynthesis, the TCA cycle, nitrogen and sulfur assimilation and DNA replication simultaneously. That breadth is the review's argument for why Fe/S biology deserves attention ahead of cryptochrome.

Ferredoxin (FD1, FD2) tier T2 (reported) quantum class: iron_sulfur_2Fe2S nuclei: 57Fe, 33S AGI: AT1G10960, AT1G60950 Vigani2021: Geomagnetic field conditions modulate iron-sulfur interplay in Arabidopsis, particularly under combined iron and sulfur deficiency. [10.3390/ijms221810166] rationale: The distribution hub of plastid reducing power. A perturbation here reaches carbon fixation, nitrogen and sulfur assimilation and redox regulation at once, which is why the review nominates ferredoxin biogenesis specifically.

svg.text: One of two maps the review motivates but does not draw. That is an odd gap, because mineral
nutrition is where the direct Arabidopsis near-null-field evidence is strongest: three separate
studies report effects on root mineral nutrition, iron uptake efficiency and Fe-S interplay. The
map makes the loop visible. Sulfate assimilation supplies the sulfide that every cluster on
QBM-04 is built from, and sulfite reductase is itself a ferredoxin-dependent siroheme-[4Fe-4S]
enzyme drawing on plastid reducing power from QBM-02 — so iron and sulfur status are not two
inputs but one feedback system, which is exactly why Vigani et al. found the effect most
pronounced under combined Fe and S deficiency. Note the tier pattern: uptake and assimilation
are T2 on real evidence, but they are classed as structural context because no quantum route is
proposed for them. A demonstrated effect with no mechanism is recorded here as precisely that.
Derived from: Motivated by section 6 and the Islam 2020 / Vigani 2021 / Narayana 2018
evidence in Porterfield & Barker, "Plant Responses to Near-Null Magnetic Fields" — no
corresponding figure exists in the manuscript. Node counts by evidence tier: T2=4, T3=3, T4=3.
Schematic topology only — no quantitative value is encoded in this base map; numbers appear
only when measured data is projected onto it.
